name: mistral-chat-flow
description: React + TypeScript chat app with a React Flow conversation view, backed by the Mistral API (official TypeScript SDK)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "tsx watch server/server.ts" "vite client"
scripts.build: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json && vite build client
